datasets.title: Guatemala: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Guatemala: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/guatemala-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

contact_point.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: Building footprints were automatically extracted from commercial satellite imagery using machine learning techniques. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics were then spatially allocated to building locations using a dasymetric mapping approach developed in partnership with Columbia University, resulting in high-resolution gridded population density maps disaggregated by demographic cohorts.

sources.name: Facebook Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial framework for population distribution modeling.

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology that overlays census data and demographic statistics onto building-level spatial units to generate high-resolution population density maps.
